candidate: On a branch from the sealed S3 snapshot, run the toolkit-layer interior-first tee assembly Calculation (ports/early/s3TeeAssembly.mjs) over the pinned provider's S3 evidence (the tee's findPx frame component ref materialized against the bright label field, and the ring record from px.tees.rings): assemble each of the 18 baseline tee Parts through the phase-1 assembly shape with the enclosed interior PxSet as the declared base and the frame component fused onto it, the ring center carried as the Part's anchor (not the frame component's centroid), and per-tee window ownership accounted against the frame component bbox; materialize px.tees.assembly under fg.s3.pxTees.assembly. The provider records the interior only as ring geometry (center, bbox, holeArea), never as a pixel set, so the interior set is derived from the branch's bright mask as the enclosed complement component inside the frame window and gated exactly against the recorded holeArea and ring bbox.
expectedBenefit: The tee becomes a whole sprite Part: the enclosed interior its frame surrounds is owned by the Part instead of living only as ring geometry on another Part, the assembly structure crosses the toolkit seam as named Parts (interior base, frame fused) with the ring-center anchor and window-residue accounting, and the fused set's growth over the baseline frame-only set is receipted per tee.
falsifier: Any tee's frame set differs from the baseline tee px set by even one pixel, the frame union differs from 4,884, any tee's derived interior set size differs from its ring's recorded holeArea, any tee's component overlap is nonzero, or S0, S1, or S2 emissions change.
